title: Optometry Student Workshop
body_html:
The Queensland Eye Institute invites QUT final-year optometry students to an exciting evening of therapeutic interactive workshops led by our expert ophthalmologists.

Details and registration link below.
details_html:
Join eight of our ophthalmologists for an interactive teaching event featuring hands-on practice in corneal foreign body removal, intravitreal injections, basic suturing techniques, glaucoma and nasolacrimal drainage assessment.

Date:

Monday, 11 August 2025

Schedule:

5.45pm: Arrival and sign-in

6.00 – 6.30pm: Dinner and network

6.30 – 8.15pm: Rotate through five interactive stations

8.15 – 8.30pm: Quiz and prizes

8.30pm: Event close

Place:

Queensland Eye Institute
Level 1
87 Ipswich Rd
Woolloongabba

View map

Cost:

Free (but must register to attend)

Other:

Numbers are strictly limited and RSVP booking is essential to secure your place.
